name: Easy Hotel Booking – WordPress Hotel Booking Plugin | WooCommerce Booking
author: themewant

sections.description:
Easy Hotel Booking is a powerful and user-friendly hotel booking plugin designed to make managing your hotel or accommodation service straightforward. It supports a complete booking engine, including room management, flexible booking options, and seamless payment integration via WooCommerce.

With an intuitive interface, this plugin allows you to create multiple room types, set seasonal pricing, showcase amenities, and accept online reservations effortlessly. Perfect for hotels, hostels, bed & breakfasts, and vacation rentals.

Live Demo & Features | Documentation | Support

Almaris Premium Theme

Key Features:

  • Room Management: Create, edit, and manage different room types like single, double, deluxe, etc.
  • Room Extra Services: Display a extra services in single room view page where user can take extra serives if needed.
  • Booking Engine: A customizable booking form with flexible check-in and check-out options.
  • Multi-Room Booking: Support for booking multiple rooms in a single reservation.
  • Seasonal Pricing: Set custom prices for specific seasons, holidays, or weekends.
  • Holiday: Set Holiday at Avalibility Calendar so user can’t book hotel on this day.
  • External Booking: We can add external Booking link when we set external Booking from settings.
  • Disable Booking: You can remove Booking system only showcase your Room.
  • Availability Calendar: We added availability calendar at single room page where you can easily visible available
    Date.
  • WooCommerce Integration: Leverage WooCommerce for payments, supporting multiple gateways such as PayPal, Stripe, and more.
  • Room Descriptions: Add detailed descriptions, amenities, and photo galleries for each room type.

HOTEL BOOKING THEMES

Take a look at Premium Hotel Booking Theme -Almaris Theme that are developed to work perfectly with Easy Hotel WordPress Plugin. These incredible WordPress Themes are the best for your hotel business with the clean and modern design. From more than 8 demos, you can easily chose the most suitable one which fits your purpose and customize it as your style.

Features

  1. Room Management:

    • Create and manage multiple room types (Single, Double, Deluxe, etc.).
    • Set room availability and capacity per room type.
    • Add detailed descriptions, amenities, and image galleries for each room.
    • Configure seasonal and custom pricing rules.

  2. Booking Engine:

    • Customizable booking form with flexible check-in and check-out date selection.
    • Availability calendar for real-time room availability.
    • Multi-room booking feature to allow group and family bookings.
    • Integration with WooCommerce for handling payments.

  3. WooCommerce Integration:

    • Supports all WooCommerce-compatible payment gateways (PayPal, Stripe, etc.).
    • Take secure payments directly from your website.
    • Manage booking payments and refunds via the WooCommerce dashboard.

  4. User-Friendly Interface:

    • Simple and intuitive admin dashboard for easy management.
    • Visual calendar for booking management.
    • Drag-and-drop functionality for room and booking adjustments.

  5. Additional Features:

    • Detailed booking history for both admins and customers.
    • Email notifications for booking confirmations, cancellations, and reminders.
    • Built-in shortcodes to display booking forms and calendars anywhere on your site.
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard
1. Visit ‘Plugin > Add new’.
2. Search for ‘Easy Hotel Booking’.
3. Activate Easy Hotel Booking from your Plugins page.

From WordPress.org
1. Search, select and download Easy Hotel Booking.
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use this plugin?

Yes, WooCommerce is required for processing payments. Please make sure to install and activate WooCommerce for payment options.

How do I add rooms to the booking system?

Go to the ‘Easy Hotel’ menu in the WordPress dashboard and click ‘Add New Accodomation’. Enter the room details, images, amenities, and set the availability.

Can I customize the booking form fields?

Yes, you can customize the booking form fields from the plugin settings. This allows you to add/remove fields as needed.

Does the plugin support seasonal pricing?

Yes, you can set custom pricing rules for specific seasons, weekends, and holidays from the pricing settings.

What payment methods are supported?

Payment methods are managed via WooCommerce, which supports multiple gateways like PayPal, Stripe, and direct bank transfers.
